''See also: [[Yerin Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Death Monarch Yerin Arelius{{!}}Yerin Arelius is a formidable [[sacred artist]] and the [[disciple]] of a [[Sage]], specifically associated with the [[Path of the Endless Sword]]. A member of the [[Arelius family]], she is described as a wiry, battle-hardened warrior with black hair and facial scars. Her combat style is characterized by the use of multiple silver [[sword]]-arms known as Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns, which emerge from her back, and she wields various blades, including a white-bladed [[sword]]. Her physical capabilities include an [[Iron body]] that allows for immense speed and strength. Yerin is a prodigy whose pure [[spirit]] reflects her high-level training. Throughout her journey, she has served as an apprentice to both a [[Sage]] and [[Eithan]]. She maintains a close, protective relationship with Lindon{{!}}Wei Shi Lindon, often acting as his guide or companion through dangerous territories like the [[Desolate Wilds]]. Her philosophy regarding existence emphasizes that challenge, danger, and death are natural and necessary components of life. Despite her intense and sometimes distant demeanor, she possesses a deep sense of loyalty to those she considers home or allies.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yerin has black hair, often with a red streak or lock, and eyes that can blaze red like [[scripts]]. Her skin is marked by a network of razor-thin scars, and she has been seen with red eyes and pale skin. She frequently wears black robes or armor, though she has also worn white [[Heaven's Glory]] clothes and formal layers of black, violet, and silver.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yerin possesses a pure and clean [[spirit]], though she is prone to intense rage that often outweighs her fear. She is a determined combatant who refuses to back down from others and is deeply committed to protecting her companions, [[Lindon]], [[Eithan]], and [[Mercy]]. Her temperament can be restless, and she has expressed feelings of jealousy toward [[Mercy]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A practitioner of the [[Path of the Endless Sword]], Yerin utilizes [[sword madra]], silver [[aura]], and [[blood madra]] to execute techniques such as the [[Flowing Sword]], the [[Endless Sword]], and the [[Moonlight Bridge]]. She can manifest multiple [[Goldsign arms]] from her back that function as blades and utilizes a [[Blood Shadow]], which is a crimson spiritual copy of herself. Her repertoire also includes the [[Phoenix Song]], the [[Hidden Sword]], and various [[Enforcer]] and [[Striker techniques]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Disciple of the Sword Sage}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|As a [[disciple]] of the [[Sword Sage]], Yerin follows the [[Path of the Endless Sword]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c11">''Unsouled'', chapter 11</ref> She is a warrior characterized by blade-straight hair, shredded black robes, and a network of scars stretching from her fingertips to her wrists.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c16">''Unsouled'', chapter 16</ref> Though her boundary is not particularly powerful and requires little energy to operate, she believes a [[sacred artist]] must shed [[blood]] when the time is right.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17">''Unsouled'', chapter 17</ref> Born a [[Ruler]], Yerin seeks to harvest the [[Remnant]] of her master, who was an expert without peer.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" /> She has forged a flat shimmer in the air that resembles a [[sword]] hammered from pure force.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" /> While she can use [[sword madra]] to break [[scripts]], Yerin also wears tattered black clothes and a stolen Iron{{!}}iron badge.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c18">''Unsouled'', chapter 18</ref> While flying a rosy cloud toward the [[Ancestor's Tomb]], she utilizes the [[Endless Sword]] [[technique]] to fight a [[Remnant]] with her [[sword]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c19">''Unsouled'', chapter 19</ref> Yerin possesses a [[gold badge]] with a [[sword]] pictured in the center, wears another [[gold badge]] around her neck, and has a [[steel]] limb on her back that resembles one of the six blades on the Remnant of the Sword Sage{{!}}Sword Sage's Remnant.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c20">''Unsouled'', chapter 20</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Miner in the valley}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Yerin is a miner who has begun to question the true identity of [[Eithan]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14">''Soulsmith'', chapter 14</ref> While she protested that [[Lindon]] lacked sturdiness, she demonstrated her own prowess as a peak [[Jade stage]] combatant with a flawless foundation and the use of [[sword madra]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15">''Soulsmith'', chapter 15</ref> After [[Eithan]] left her to watch over [[Lindon]], she fought almost without rest for a full night and most of the following day.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16">''Soulsmith'', chapter 16</ref> During her travels as a combatant running with [[Lindon]], she utilized a twisted seashell [[binding]] to spray [[water]] and saw her [[Goldsign]] flash during an attack by a [[Remnant]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c17">''Soulsmith'', chapter 17</ref> She engaged [[Jai Long]] with a wave of [[sword madra]] and was present during the confrontation with Sandviper Kral{{!}}Kral.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c18">''Soulsmith'', chapter 18</ref> Despite being outclassed in power by [[Jai Long]], Yerin displayed high skill and possesses a bladed [[Goldsign]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c20">''Soulsmith'', chapter 20</ref> She was trained by a master who used to say that no [[Path]] is wide enough for two.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c20" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Yerin, a sixteen-year-old former [[Iron]] with a spirit-sense{{!}}spiritual sense, is present alongside [[Lindon]] and [[Eithan]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c5">''Blackflame'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c11">''Blackflame'', chapter 11</ref> She is a [[Goldsign]] with stable [[madra]] who practices [[cycling]] meditation and trains early in the morning.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c5" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c7">''Blackflame'', chapter 7</ref> A scarred individual with red skin and black hair, she possesses a silver limb and wears tattered black clothing.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c6">''Blackflame'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c7" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c8">''Blackflame'', chapter 8</ref> As the top-ranked student of the outer family, she uses her [[Goldsign]] to wield the [[Endless Sword]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c8" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c11" /> Yerin is [[Eithan]]'s little sister and a spear user who possesses [[blood madra]] and silver [[aura]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c15">''Blackflame'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c17">''Blackflame'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c18">''Blackflame'', chapter 18</ref> After absorbing the [[Remnant]] of her master, the [[Sword Sage]]—who was much stronger than an [[Underlord]]—she advanced from [[Lowgold]] to [[Highgold]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c7" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c13">''Blackflame'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c19">''Blackflame'', chapter 19</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Seeking in Skysworn}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Yerin is the girl whom Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel instructed [[Lindon]] to seek, and she serves as a reluctant host to a sealed [[Blood Shadow]] that she wears around her waist like a belt.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c2">''Skysworn'', chapter 2</ref> An eighteen-year-old [[Highgold]] practitioner, she seeks the voice of the [[Sword Sage]] while [[cycling]] and is rumored to have been a [[disciple]] of a [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c2" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3">''Skysworn'', chapter 3</ref> After helping [[Lindon]] prepare for his duel, she informed him of [[Jai Long]]'s comparison of him to a [[Blackflame]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c4">''Skysworn'', chapter 4</ref> Though she possesses a [[Blood Shadow]], Yerin was once discovered bloody and broken upon the [[stone]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c8">''Skysworn'', chapter 8</ref> She is a [[sacred artist]] with blades on her shoulders and a [[Goldsign]] that may be beyond her control, yet she remains unable to read.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c10">''Skysworn'', chapter 10</ref> An emissary of [[Redmoon Hall]] who has earned rewards from the [[Arelius family]], Yerin intends to pursue those raising swords against her hall and hopes to join the [[Skysworn]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c10" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c11">''Skysworn'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c15">''Skysworn'', chapter 15</ref> Having learned the cost of [[sacred arts]] from her master, she entered the room where [[Lindon]] worked with [[constructs]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c11" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c12">''Skysworn'', chapter 12</ref> An adopted companion of [[Eithan]], she has spent nearly two years following [[Bai Rou]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c13">''Skysworn'', chapter 13</ref> As a participant in the [[Highgold]] course who passed her application in first place, she maintains [[madra]] that is rock-stable for a [[Lowgold]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c15" /> While the parasite failed to enter her core, [[Yerin's spirit]] is exhausted from preventing the [[Blood Shadow]] from taking over, though her rage remains stronger than her fear.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c16">''Skysworn'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c17">''Skysworn'', chapter 17</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Ghostwater journey}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|While held in [[chains]] and shackles, Yerin possessed two blade-ended arms of [[Forged]] [[silver madra]] extending from her back.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2">''Ghostwater'', chapter 2</ref> Her Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns consist of [[Forged]] [[silver madra]] blades, and her [[Blood Shadow]] is a mass of living [[blood madra]] that forms a copy of her.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4">''Ghostwater'', chapter 4</ref> After passing through the Jade{{!}}jade doorway [[sword]]-first, she utilized the [[Rippling Sword Striker]] [[technique]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4" /> Refusing to leave [[Lindon]] behind, she attempted to reach a [[portal]] to save him.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c5">''Ghostwater'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref> Despite having an empty core, she met with the [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c7">''Ghostwater'', chapter 7</ref> Yerin taught [[Lindon]] combat principles and follows the [[Path of the Endless Sword]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c10">''Ghostwater'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c11">''Ghostwater'', chapter 11</ref> Her [[madra]] is dense enough to cross the barrier to [[Truegold]], though her Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns were folded over her shoulders and she is currently separated from [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c11" /> Though [[Lindon]] mentions her, she has been apart from him for a long time.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c13">''Ghostwater'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15">''Ghostwater'', chapter 15</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">24</span></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Skysworn cloudship pilot}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Yerin serves as the pilot of the [[Skysworn cloudship]] and is a practitioner of the [[sacred arts]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c2">''Underlord'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c19">''Underlord'', chapter 19</ref> A combatant who utilizes three blades and seamless movement, she can slash [[acidic madra]] from the air using pulses of tightly controlled [[sword madra]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3">''Underlord'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5">''Underlord'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11">''Underlord'', chapter 11</ref> Her silver Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns can be withdrawn into her back, where she can manifest six arms of [[sword madra]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c4">''Underlord'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8">''Underlord'', chapter 8</ref> During a race to the end of [[Truegold]], she beat [[Lindon]] by ten seconds, after which he promised her the remaining [[Spirit Well water]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8" /> Clad in [[Skysworn armor]], Yerin possesses [[soulfire]] and the ability to [[veil]] her [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c18">''Underlord'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c19" /> Despite her strength, she suffered severe damage to her lifeline and entered a dying state that required treatment from [[Brightcrown]] healers.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c12">''Underlord'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14">''Underlord'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15">''Underlord'', chapter 15</ref> While her goal is to become an [[Underlady]], her [[advancement]] would require her [[soulfire]] to rebuild her damaged lifeline.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Uncrowned King tournament}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|While competing in the Uncrowned King Tournament{{!}}Uncrowned King tournament, Yerin utilizes six gleaming [[sword]]-arms and Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns that sweep like claws.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2">''Uncrowned'', chapter 2</ref> Her sword aura{{!}}sword-aura is capable of detonating into the [[Endless Sword]], and she also employs the [[Shadow]] [[technique]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4">''Uncrowned'', chapter 4</ref> Although she is not an Arelius family{{!}}Arelius by birth, she was adopted into the family.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8">''Uncrowned'', chapter 8</ref> Yerin uses a blindfold to focus her perception, allowing her to feel [[madra]] rather than seeing with her eyes.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8" /> Her master was nearly married to the Frozen Blade{{!}}Sage of the Frozen Blade.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4" /> She communicates with [[Lindon]] through a jewel-[[construct]] made of purple crystalline material that utilizes dream and [[shadow madra]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c7">''Uncrowned'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8" /> A former [[Highgold]], Yerin possesses perception and has advanced to the [[Underlord]] stage with [[Diamond Veins]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19">''Uncrowned'', chapter 19</ref> In combat, her sword aura{{!}}sword-aura can annihilate large ranks of weaker enemies, and she has used the [[Endless Sword]] to protect [[Naru Saeya]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c11">''Uncrowned'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c13">''Uncrowned'', chapter 13</ref> Her crimson [[Blood Shadow]] serves as a spiritual copy of herself and acts as a factor in battle.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c14">''Uncrowned'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20">''Uncrowned'', chapter 20</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Apprentice of the Winter Sage}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Yerin is the apprentice of [[Timaias Adama]], having left with him as a subordinate.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c1">''Wintersteel'', chapter 1</ref> A [[Jade]] with a parasite in her soul, she possesses power on the level of an [[Archlord]] and is a potential future [[Sage of the Endless Sword]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c1" /> As a fighter associated with [[Malice]], she remains in the competition and utilizes a gem-like dream tablets{{!}}dream tablet.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c2">''Wintersteel'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref> A companion to [[Lindon]] and [[Eithan]], Yerin watched the fight from the [[Akura audience platform]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c4">''Wintersteel'', chapter 4</ref> Despite a false announcement that she would fight [[Mercy]], Yerin is scheduled for a month of training with a [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref> Dressed in formal layers of black, violet, and silver, she possesses powers similar to [[Blacksword]] while watching the [[Uncrowned]] matches alongside [[Lindon]] and [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref> After wearing a standard black uniform and closing her eyes amidst swirling nine-colored light, she was chosen as a pupil by the [[Winter Sage]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref> Yerin gathered with [[Mercy]] and [[Eithan]] at the end of the [[cloudship]] dock, where she stays in a network of wooden huts.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8">''Wintersteel'', chapter 8</ref> Having previously trained to sense [[sword aura]] in the freezing cold, she uses her spirit-sense{{!}}spiritual sense and the [[Hidden Sword]] [[technique]] to fight, though her [[Forger technique]] is brittle and weak despite an adequate foundation.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" /> The heir to the [[Endless Sword]] was once nearly killed by Riyusai Meira{{!}}Meira.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c10">''Wintersteel'', chapter 10</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|While [[Eithan]] is able to funnel [[advancement]] resources to her, Yerin recently fought a demon in a snowy village during a conflict involving a [[Monarch-killing weapon]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c11">''Wintersteel'', chapter 11</ref> Her [[madra]] causes her [[sword]] to glow silver, and despite being considered one of the most eligible young women in the world, she hoped [[Eithan]] had permission for his actions.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c12">''Wintersteel'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c14">''Wintersteel'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c15">''Wintersteel'', chapter 15</ref> After providing encouragement to [[Mercy]], Yerin engaged in a battle with [[Lindon]] and became the sole remaining participant in the [[tournament]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c16">''Wintersteel'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17">''Wintersteel'', chapter 17</ref> Her spirits lifted when the [[Ninecloud Soul]] manifested, and she used her [[sword]] along with calming breaths to maintain her [[madra]] flow.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17" /> Sensing both her dormant [[Blood Shadow]] and the flow of [[sword madra]], she struggled as her core drained and her [[spirit]] trembled while controlling the [[Frozen Blade]] [[technique]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17" /> The [[Ninecloud Soul]] announced her as the winner, and she subsequently fell toward [[Lindon]] with a raised [[sword]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18">''Wintersteel'', chapter 18</ref> While at the [[Frozen Blade school]], Yerin decoded instructions to absorb a power into her core and participated in discussions regarding the final gift.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19">''Wintersteel'', chapter 19</ref> She provoked the [[Blood Sage]] with insults and later witnessed mirror images of herself from her own memories.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c20">''Wintersteel'', chapter 20</ref> As she faced [[Calan Archer]], Yerin saw her own serene expression from the outside while her core remained full but inactive during the settling of the [[Madra Engine]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c20" /> Cycling [[sword aura]] within a forest of blades, she demanded that [[Charity]] go get them.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c20" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21">''Wintersteel'', chapter 21</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Fighting to ensure the safety of [[Lindon]], [[Eithan]], and [[Mercy]], Yerin remains undeterred by those who speak to her while on the path toward becoming a [[Sword Sage]] once she reaches [[Archlord]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c22" /> A recent competition winner and one of the [[tournament]]'s top two fighters, she was scheduled to face [[Yan Shoumei]] but instead dealt with an attempt by the [[Blood Shadow]] to act against her.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23">''Wintersteel'', chapter 23</ref> While wary of the [[Shadow]]'s gaze toward [[Lindon]], Yerin revealed to her Overlord that she is not him.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c24">''Wintersteel'', chapter 24</ref> As she marched through tunnels to a waiting room with [[Ruby]], Yerin prepared for battle against Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara using her Steelborn body{{!}}Steelborn Iron body and mental enhancements from the The Eight-Man Empire{{!}}Eight-Man Empire.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25">''Wintersteel'', chapter 25</ref> Although she can use the [[Blood Sage]]'s [[technique]] to send power to her [[Blood Shadow]], the former [[Underlord]] was decapitated by Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara after slamming her blade into her opponent's.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25" /> Utilizing red and [[silver madra]], Yerin employed the [[soulfire]]-empowered [[Flowing Sword technique]] by [[cycling]] [[madra]] into it.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref> She used the [[Moonlight Bridge]] to appear behind Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara and unleashed the [[Final Sword]], a [[technique]] that produced red-[[white light]] blasting through the image of the golden [[dragon]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26" /> After [[Dross]] reported her victory in the fight, Yerin might see Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara saving [[Akura Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref> While watching [[Malice]] fight the [[Dragon King]], Yerin intended to use [[Penance]] and the [[Moonlight Bridge]], but she appeared in a white glow only to be pinned in place by the Heart and Winter [[Sages]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Yerin is a person for whom an echo could be created and is someone [[Lindon]] intends to call.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2">''Dreadgod'', chapter 2</ref> Appearing in a flash of [[white light]] on the back of a ship floating on the sea, she carries a black blade [[sword]] known as [[Netherclaw]] and is considered a defective [[Herald]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref> As one of the six beings threatened by the [[Silent King]], she is a character for whom [[Lindon]] is developing a complex [[construct]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref> After learning what she can, Yerin intends to strip [[Redmoon Hall]] down to their bones while aboard a vessel belonging to them.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5">''Dreadgod'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7">''Dreadgod'', chapter 7</ref> She possesses a [[void key]] and is mentioned by both [[Dross]] and [[Malice]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c6">''Dreadgod'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c8">''Dreadgod'', chapter 8</ref> An [[Overlord Herald]] whose parents were killed by [[Blood Shadows]], Yerin maintains a body and [[spirit]] in closer harmony than any other Overlord.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9">''Dreadgod'', chapter 9</ref> She uses [[blood madra]] to heal herself and possesses a [[soulspace]] that allows her to translate the squeaks of [[Riverseed]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9" /> An associate of [[Lindon]] and [[Mercy]], she also has a relationship with a [[Blood Shadow]] that will become [[Ruby]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c10">''Dreadgod'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c11">''Dreadgod'', chapter 11</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Apprentice of Eithan}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|As an apprentice of Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius, Yerin is a [[Riverseed]] capable of fighting [[Dreadgods]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c11" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12">''Dreadgod'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c14">''Dreadgod'', chapter 14</ref> She utilizes a hunger spears{{!}}hunger spear in combat and was passed by the [[Blood Sage]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c14" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15">''Dreadgod'', chapter 15</ref> While hunting for [[natural treasures]] among her master's belongings, she pushes for [[advancement]] and displays a crimson [[vital aura]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17">''Dreadgod'', chapter 17</ref> After using a [[void key]] to strike a deal with the [[Remnant]], she fought alongside the [[Blood Sage]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref> Yerin possesses scarlet Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns, a red streak of hair, and a soul-oath{{!}}soul oath.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref> She questioned why the [[Dreadgods]] and [[Monarchs]] were pursuing them, as she is a person who plans to ascend one day.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref> [[Lindon]] felt her [[madra]] while she waited for him at the former site of the Heaven’s Glory School{{!}}Heaven's Glory School near the [[Ancestor's Tomb]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" /> Yerin can pluck memories from the air and vanish in a flash of light, once waiting for memory [[constructs]] to arrange themselves around her.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22">''Dreadgod'', chapter 22</ref> At the entrance to the [[Soulforge]], she possesses six Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns and an [[Archlord]] blade.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23">''Dreadgod'', chapter 23</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Battle of Weeping Dragon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|While traveling to the battle, Yerin fought through [[lightning-dragons]] and a hostile storm after attempting to activate her [[Moonlight Bridge]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref> Having already departed on her own, she flew at high speeds toward the combat area like a silver-and-red comet.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> The individual whom [[Orthos]] had dealt with previously utilized her twin [[Remnants]] and the stolen power of a [[Sage]] and a [[Herald]] to sustain herself.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> Driven by arrogance and the intent to execute the [[Dreadgod]], she floated using only her will without manipulating Wind aura{{!}}wind aura.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> As the dragons{{!}}Dragon focused its claws and lightning on her, Yerin suffered numerous burns, cuts, and bruises.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref> Despite her [[madra]] being incompatible with the [[Weeping Dragon]]'s, she was eventually found wrapped in many bandages.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23">''Waybound'', chapter 23</ref> One of [[Lindon]]'s flunkies, she was later seen meditating on the eighth [[Path of Heaven]] in [[Ghostwind Hall]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26">''Waybound'', chapter 26</ref> With eyes that blaze red like [[Fury]]'s, she cycled her [[madra]] to its limit to remain standing under [[Malice]]'s Authority{{!}}authority.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26" /> While working on [[Eithan]]'s attack, she remained restless.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28">''Waybound'', chapter 28</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Journey through the Way}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|While flying through a gap between the [[Dreadgods]], Yerin maintained her pace with [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c29" /> During the encounter, [[Reigan Shen]] utilized Yerin's [[Moonlight Bridge]] to redirect her movement.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref> She employs [[black-and-white Striker techniques]] that leave cuts carrying echoes of death.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30" /> Her ascension was less smooth than that of [[Fury]], yet she used her [[Goldsign]] to cut a hole in Way{{!}}the Way.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31">''Waybound'', chapter 31</ref> After having warned [[Larian]], Yerin was not found on the other side of the rift opened by [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c33">''Waybound'', chapter 33</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36">''Waybound'', chapter 36</ref> [[Lindon]] expressed concern that she might have been jailed, noting that she wears black armor.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c37">''Waybound'', chapter 37</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yerin possesses a [[Blood Shadow]] with the ability to forge a claw.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 3</ref> She is tasked with resolving problems that can be killed, and it is noted that she would have been able to dispatch the [[Fiend]] rapidly.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 6</ref> While [[Lindon]] expressed a desire to send her a message, [[Dross]] later made mention of her.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 11</ref> Having advanced to the rank of [[Overlady]] [[Herald]], Yerin traveled through Way{{!}}the Way as part of a group including [[Lindon]] and [[Eithan]], during which time she leaned her elbow on [[Lindon]]'s head.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref> She envisioned her [[fragment]] as a place where life could flourish and spread, eventually suggesting the name [[Refuge]] for that world.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" /> After emerging from a [[Way-portal]] alongside [[Lindon]] amidst [[Abidan]] warnings, the [[Death Monarch Yerin Arelius]] visited her birthplace and remarked that the town felt like home.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 13</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“He was,” Yerin said, her voice distant.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“Need to harvest his Remnant,” she said, stretching.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|“He's strong,” she said to Lindon, though even she kept her comment to barely above a whisper.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Behind him, Yerin protested. “He's about as sturdy as a newborn kitten.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|“I’ll admit that’s been my experience,” Yerin allowed, “but my master used to say that no Path is wide enough for two.”<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c20" />}}
